scenario:
A financial analytics company is developing an enterprise-level market data analysis platform focused on cryptocurrency trading. The platform aims to provide traders, analysts, and financial institutions with comprehensive tools to monitor market trends, perform technical analysis, and make informed trading decisions.

The system will collect and store historical and real-time market data for a wide range of cryptocurrencies, capturing metrics such as opening and closing prices, high and low values, trading volume, and precise timestamps for each data point. Users will require advanced analytical capabilities, including the ability to generate custom reports, visualize trends with interactive charts, and apply technical indicators.

The platform must support the integration of various external data sources and APIs, allowing users to enrich their analyses with additional financial data. It should also facilitate automated trading strategies by providing programmatic access to market data and supporting algorithmic trading scripts.

A robust user management system is necessary to ensure secure access to sensitive financial data, with roles and permissions tailored to individual users and organizational needs. Furthermore, data integrity and reliability are critical, requiring mechanisms for data validation, error handling, and audit logging.
